message.content: {"caption":"Stacked area chart of cumulative costs across a normalized timeline","description":"A stacked area chart plots cumulative cost (k USD) against normalized timeline (%). The x-axis runs from 0 to 100, with ticks at 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100; the y-axis runs from 0 to 250, with ticks every 50. The pale-green bottom band is “environment scaling”: it rises steeply early in the timeline and levels off near 130 k USD around 60%. The bright-green middle band, “RSI infrastructure, GPU,” begins to grow around the middle and rises to about 70 k USD by 100%. The peach top band, “agent judge, verifier, attribution,” adds cost above the other bands; the overall cumulative total rises to about 240 k USD at 100%. Approximate component-band values at x=0, 25, 50, 75, and 100 are given in chart_values. Their stacked upper boundaries are approximately 0, 60, 160, 215, and 242 k USD, respectively. Two dotted vertical guides mark about 40% and 60%. Green arrows point down and right to markers on the total curve: “training start” at about 40%, where the total is about 115 k USD, and “env. scaling end” at about 60%, where it is about 175 k USD. A final dot marks the total near 242 k USD at 100%.
